4.1.3.4-24a.title: Maximum-lift increment for low-aspect-ratio wings (subsonic)

calibration.method: skew-aware piecewise-linear: each printed gridline measured as pixel position = c0 + c1*t (rows: y = c0 + c1*px; cols: x = c0 + c1*py) from dark-pixel centroids in several bands; value = piecewise-linear interpolation between the two local gridlines bracketing the point (linear extrapolation beyond outermost). Implemented in cal.py (Cal.value).
calibration.global_linear_summary: x = -4.66844 + 0.0089173*px (max resid 0.026 x-units = 2.9 px, scan non-uniformity; piecewise model has <0.9 px residual); y = 1.22705 - 0.00089320*py (max resid 0.0008)
calibration.notes: gridlines every 1 x-unit (0..14, labels at even values) and every 0.1 in Delta C_Lmax (-0.2..0.4, labels .4 .2 0 -.2). Scan rotation ~0.002 rad.

4.1.3.4-24a.method: pass1 = by-eye readings from ruler crops (taken before pass 2); pass2 = column-wise dark-run centres (threshold 110/255) converted through the calibration, sampled by local linear fit over +-4 px; samples listed in pass2_bridged_or_extrapolated_x were obtained by quadratic fit across a gap (gridline crossing / label) or, marked 'end-extrap', by linear extrapolation of the last 8 drawn points to an end hidden under an axis line.

common_trunk.notes: Single curve shared by all Mach numbers from x=0 to the split. From x=0 to ~1.0 it lies on/just below the -0.1 gridline; there the centre was recovered from the outer edge of the merged dark band (edge.py, half-thickness 2.5 px; uncertainty ~+-1 px = +-0.001). It starts at the y-axis at about -0.106 (just below the -0.1 gridline), not exactly -0.100.

M<=0.2.notes: Upper curve (label 'M <= .2'); visually continuous with the common trunk, so pass2 includes the trunk for x<4.14. Drawn right end at x=13.77 (stops short of x=14; the last ~10 px is broken/dashed in the print). Gap 4.0-4.14 bridged (crossing of the 0 gridline).

M=0.4.notes: Middle curve (label '.4'). Its drawn line begins as a FREE END at x=5.44, Delta C_Lmax=0.071, lying between the M<=0.2 line (0.081 there) and the M=0.6 line (0.064); it does not touch the trunk. Below x=5.44 the chart presumably intends the common trunk, but that is not drawn; no data given there. Drawn right end x=13.81.

M=0.6.notes: Lowest curve (label '.6'). Departs from the trunk at x~4.50 (Delta C_Lmax ~0.026), touching it; pass2 includes the trunk for x<4.50. The last ~15 px (x 13.66-13.84) run along the 0.1 gridline; centre recovered from band edges. Drawn right end x=13.84 at ~0.096. Pass-1 errors of 0.008-0.013 at x=5,6 were checked with independent column slices (x=1193 px: line at y=1284 px) and are pass-1 misreads.

judgement_calls: Trunk assigned to M<=0.2 (visually continuous) and to M=0.6 below its tangent split at x~4.50; M=0.4 has a free start at x=5.44 and is NOT extended to the trunk.
Curves end at x~13.8, not 14; values at x=14 are not given.

calibration.global_linear_summary: x = -0.56813 + 0.0014051*px; y = 9.37386 - 0.0035045*py (at px=760; rows tilt +0.0135 px/px, i.e. ~0.8 deg scan rotation: use the skew-aware model)
calibration.notes: gridlines at lambda 0,.2,.4,.6,.8,1.0 and C1 0,.5,1.0. Zero gridline is slightly bowed (1.4 px max residual = 0.005 in C1).

4.1.3.4-24b_C1.method: pass1 = by-eye readings from ruler crops (taken before pass 2); pass2 = column-wise dark-run centres (threshold 110/255) converted through the calibration, sampled by local linear fit over +-4 px; samples listed in pass2_bridged_or_extrapolated_x were obtained by quadratic fit across a gap (gridline crossing / label) or, marked 'end-extrap', by linear extrapolation of the last 8 drawn points to an end hidden under an axis line.

C1.notes: Peak (lambda 0.2-0.3) lies ON the 0.5 gridline: from lambda=0.20 to 0.30 the curve is merged with the gridline; centre recovered from merged-band edges (top edge never rises above the gridline top, so the peak is <=0.50; recovered peak 0.5015 at lambda=0.25, uncertainty ~+-0.005). For lambda>=0.90 the curve merges into the zero gridline; recovered from the top edge up to lambda=0.976 (0.0128); for lambda 0.976-1.0 it is indistinguishable from the zero line, so the point (1.0, 0.0) is a merged-end reading, not a measured centre. Start at lambda=0 is end-extrapolated (axis corner hides the first 12 px) to -0.0016 (i.e. 0). Pass-1 errors up to 0.020 confirmed as pass-1 misreads by independent slices (e.g. lambda=0.7: slice gives 0.124).

judgement_calls: (1.0, 0.0) included as the visually merged end on the zero line.

alpha_CLmax_base.notes: Flat at 35.0 deg from x=0 to ~0.8, then decreasing. Passes through the hatched boundary at x~3.04 (hatch strokes cross the line at px 1900-1928; those columns were excluded and bridged). Drawn to x=3.6 where it ends at a short vertical tick (value 21.07 deg); the tick at x=3.6 is the end marker. Start at x=0 end-extrapolated by 4 px (35.09). Pass-1 errors up to 0.44 deg (x=1.2, 3.6) confirmed as pass-1 misreads by slices (x=1.2 slice gives 32.10).

4.1.3.4-25b.title: Angle-of-attack increment for subsonic maximum lift of low-aspect-ratio wings
4.1.3.4-25b.printed_labels: 0, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 and '-30' (dash abutting the y-axis, then '30'); there is no '1' curve; no '10' is printed. '9' is printed immediately left of/below '8'. Mach labels: 'M', '<= .2', '.4', '.6'.

calibration.method: skew-aware piecewise-linear: each printed gridline measured as pixel position = c0 + c1*t (rows: y = c0 + c1*px; cols: x = c0 + c1*py) from dark-pixel centroids in several bands; value = piecewise-linear interpolation between the two local gridlines bracketing the point (linear extrapolation beyond outermost). Implemented in cal.py (Cal.value).
calibration.notes: gridlines every 1 x-unit (0..14, labels at even values) and every 5 deg (-10..20; labels -10, 0, 10, 20). Rows tilt -0.0045 px/px. Bottom border bowed (1.9 px).

4.1.3.4-25b.method: pass1 = by-eye readings from ruler crops (taken before pass 2); pass2 = column-wise dark-run centres (threshold 110/255) converted through the calibration, sampled by local linear fit over +-4 px; samples listed in pass2_bridged_or_extrapolated_x were obtained by quadratic fit across a gap (gridline crossing / label) or, marked 'end-extrap', by linear extrapolation of the last 8 drawn points to an end hidden under an axis line. Left-family curves were traced with a column tracker (track.py) and, near the y-axis where they are steep, a row tracker (trackrow.py); merged stretches from band edges (edge.py).

P=0.notes: Starts on the +10 gridline at the y-axis (x=0 value 9.99, end-extrapolated 11 px). Interrupted by its label '0' at x~1.5-1.8 (bridged). Approaches zero from above and enters the zero gridline at x=3.93 (Delta alpha +0.20; last 13 columns from the band top edge). Beyond x=3.93 it is hidden in the gridline/convergence bundle; no data given beyond 3.93.

P=2.notes: Label printed as a small '2' at x~1.5-1.7 (bridged). Reaches the zero gridline at x~3.1, is hidden/merged from x~3.16 to 3.33 (gap bridged), reappears just BELOW the gridline (centre from band bottom edge, then a separate line) and reaches -0.38 deg at x~3.9; joins the convergence bundle (with the envelope) at x~3.94-4.2. Data end at x=3.94.

P=3.notes: Own drawn branch from x=0 to its tangency with the lower envelope (the '30'/10-30 curve) at x~3.728 (Delta alpha ~-1.077); beyond that the curve coincides with the envelope (centres within 4 px = 0.18 deg) and pass2 continues along the envelope to x=4.36 where the envelope enters the zero gridline. Value at x=0 end-extrapolated across the y-axis line (first clean column 6-13 px from the axis). Crosses the zero gridline downward at x~2.33-2.74 (shallow crossing, bridged), minimum ~-1.1 deg near x=3.6.

P=4.notes: Own drawn branch from x=0 to its tangency with the lower envelope (the '30'/10-30 curve) at x~3.12 (Delta alpha ~-2.505); beyond that the curve coincides with the envelope (centres within 4 px = 0.18 deg) and pass2 continues along the envelope to x=4.36 where the envelope enters the zero gridline. Value at x=0 end-extrapolated across the y-axis line (first clean column 6-13 px from the axis). Starts on the +5 gridline at the axis (centres from band edges, half-thickness 3.8 px). Label '4' at x~1.3-1.6 (bridged).

P=5.notes: Own drawn branch from x=0 to its tangency with the lower envelope (the '30'/10-30 curve) at x~2.259 (Delta alpha ~-4.5); beyond that the curve coincides with the envelope (centres within 4 px = 0.18 deg) and pass2 continues along the envelope to x=4.36 where the envelope enters the zero gridline. Value at x=0 end-extrapolated across the y-axis line (first clean column 6-13 px from the axis). Crosses the zero gridline at x~0.57-0.80 and is interrupted by label '5' at x~0.94-1.07 (both bridged).

P=6.notes: Own drawn branch from x=0 to its tangency with the lower envelope (the '30'/10-30 curve) at x~1.524 (Delta alpha ~-5.885); beyond that the curve coincides with the envelope (centres within 4 px = 0.18 deg) and pass2 continues along the envelope to x=4.36 where the envelope enters the zero gridline. Value at x=0 end-extrapolated across the y-axis line (first clean column 6-13 px from the axis). Interrupted by label '6' at x~0.6-0.8 and by the -5 gridline/x=1 gridline at x~1.0-1.3 (bridged). Starts in the corner of the y-axis and the zero gridline: first visible at x~0.05 just above the zero line; x=0 value +0.69 deg is a 6 px extrapolation of a steep line (uncertainty ~+-0.5 deg). Pass1 (by eye) put the start at 0.0; this is the largest pass1/pass2 disagreement (0.63 deg) and reflects this ambiguity.

P=7.notes: Own drawn branch from x=0 to its tangency with the lower envelope (the '30'/10-30 curve) at x~1.062 (Delta alpha ~-6.662); beyond that the curve coincides with the envelope (centres within 4 px = 0.18 deg) and pass2 continues along the envelope to x=4.36 where the envelope enters the zero gridline. Value at x=0 end-extrapolated across the y-axis line (first clean column 6-13 px from the axis). Interrupted by its label '7' at x~0.40-0.62 (bridged).

P=8.notes: Own drawn branch from x=0 to its tangency with the lower envelope (the '30'/10-30 curve) at x~0.795 (Delta alpha ~-7.105); beyond that the curve coincides with the envelope (centres within 4 px = 0.18 deg) and pass2 continues along the envelope to x=4.36 where the envelope enters the zero gridline. Value at x=0 end-extrapolated across the y-axis line (first clean column 6-13 px from the axis). Steep near the axis; interrupted by label '8' (x~0.39-0.53, bridged) and by the -5 gridline (rows skipped).

P=9.notes: Own drawn branch from x=0 to its tangency with the lower envelope (the '30'/10-30 curve) at x~0.662 (Delta alpha ~-7.305); beyond that the curve coincides with the envelope (centres within 4 px = 0.18 deg) and pass2 continues along the envelope to x=4.36 where the envelope enters the zero gridline. Value at x=0 end-extrapolated across the y-axis line (first clean column 6-13 px from the axis). Steep near the axis; interrupted by label '9' (x~0.29-0.53, bridged); near-axis centres (x<0.11) recovered from the top edge of the band merged with the -5 gridline (half-thickness 4.3 px): least certain curve on the chart (+-0.3 deg near x=0).

P=10-30.notes: LOWER ENVELOPE. Printed label reads '-30': a short dash attached to the y-axis followed by '30'; no '10' is visible anywhere. Interpreted (judgement) as the caller's '10-30' curve, with the dash being the stub of the curve itself at x=0.05-0.17 (Delta alpha -8.03); the curve is hidden behind the label '30' from x~0.13 to 0.56 (quadratic bridge, flagged) and continues as the thick envelope rising to the zero gridline at x=4.36 (-0.10 deg). From x~4.0 to 4.36 the centre comes from the bottom edge of the merged convergence band. Between x~0.6 and 1.2 the envelope is a thick wedge where P=9, P=8 and P=7 merge into it; centres there are uncertain by ~+-0.15 deg (visible as ~0.1 deg wiggles in pass2). Generic 25b pass-2 noise is ~+-2 px = +-0.09 deg.

M<=0.2.notes: Emerges above the zero gridline at x~4.49 (+0.15 deg; x 4.49-4.82 from band top edge). Between the convergence (~4.36-4.4) and 4.49 it is inside the gridline (|Delta alpha| <~0.15). Label 'M <= .2'. Ends at x=14 merging into the +15 gridline (last 1 px end-extrapolated; 14.95 at x=14).

M=0.4.notes: Inside the zero gridline (|Delta alpha| <~0.2 deg) until x~5.39, emerges at +0.44 (x 5.39-5.6 from band top edge). Ends at the x=14 border, 13.49 deg.

M=0.6.notes: Inside the zero gridline until x~5.60 (emerges at +0.21 deg; x 5.6-5.86 from band top edge). Ends at the x=14 border, 8.50 deg.

4.1.3.4-25b.convergence: All left-family curves converge into the zero gridline between x~4.0 and 4.4: P=0 enters it from above at x=3.93; P=2 and the envelope (carrying P=3..P=9) approach from below and enter it by x=4.36. The Mach curves leave it at x=4.49 (M<=0.2), 5.39 (M=0.4), 5.60 (M=0.6). The exact common point is hidden by the gridline; the drawing is consistent with (4.4, 0) within +-0.15 deg.
judgement_calls: '-30' label interpreted as the 10-30 curve; dash = curve stub
tangency (merge) with envelope defined as first column where the branch centre is within 4 px (0.18 deg) of the envelope centre
composite curves P=3..P=9 continue along the envelope after merge
